        else:

        else:
            prerelease_identifiers = None
        
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_identifiers)

        # None means no pre-release (release version)
        # No pre-release sorts after pre-release
        if pre1 is None and pre2 is None:
            return 0
        if pre1 is None:  # pre1 is release, pre2 is pre-release
            return 1
        if pre2 is None:  # pre1 is pre-release, pre2 is release
            return -1
        
        # Both have pre-release, compare identifiers
        for i in range(min(len(pre1), len(pre2))):

            id2 = pre2[i]
